authority.role: Sole input authority for the personal-profile runtime lane. Every staged byte is either a pinned source-of-record file (this inputs section) or an explicit command-line artifact (components section). Missing/invalid inputs refuse staging; nothing is fabricated.
authority.pinProtocol: oprofile pin re-reads every pinned source and rewrites the sha256/files fields. Deliberate owner action — stage refuses drifted inputs otherwise.
authority.noTmpDependencies: No /tmp path from the owner's composition session is baked in; example artifact locations appear only in README prose as examples.

sourcesOfRecord.dotfilesPrompts: The selected dotfiles checkout's opencode/oh-my-opencode-slim is the sole builtin-role append source. Input paths below use the main checkout, not an old worktree. Other machines relocate paths to the same approved revision without changing content hashes; prompt and raw config sources are read-only during staging.
sourcesOfRecord.liveGlobalRoot: /home/littlekey/.config/opencode supplies vibeguard.config.json only; personal skills are pinned under runtime/generated/skills.
sourcesOfRecord.coworkerPrompts: omo-coworkers/prompts owns document-writer and lark-operator bodies. Stage them byte-identically into the OMO prompt directory; raw host config retains only Lark mode:all.

authority.convergence: The composition lane selects the host-managed billion-context@latest npm channel, explicit OMO directory artifacts and the dual-host BCP artifact. Retired ACP/tui pins remain rollback history. Council overrides and *.bak-promptopt files are excluded from staging; prompt copies are byte-identical and the Explorer full override is retired in favor of its upstream base plus append. As of 2026-10-09, all eight OMO bundled skills follow the selected plugin artifact: v1 stages artifact-relative links and activation materializes original bytes; v2 inherits in-process. The former codemap/deepwork/oh-my-opencode-slim local overrides and combined build manifest are retired. skillsDir contains only 11 personal skills (the 2026-10-11 owner removal retired executing-plans and writing-plans from sources and pins; eli5 was retired the same day in its own bounded pass); input changes require deliberate, explained pin updates.

compression.v1: The npm channel is selected first through flavors.v1.stockPlugins. OpenCode resolves the public server export; no local compression artifact is accepted by this profile.
compression.v2: The same npm channel is declared in flavors.v2.stockPlugins. Native means the upstream self-spawning integration, not a built-in host engine. No ACP or local compression wrapper is staged.
compression.note: latest is a registry channel, not a startup-update guarantee. The host owns package resolution/cache; reports record actual resolved and loaded versions separately. Runtime acceptance requires host evidence and is not implied by metadata verification.

hostConfigSource.role: Raw host settings from the dotfiles source. Plugin selection is maintained only in this profile's components and flavors sections, together with explicitly supplied artifacts; the raw source has no plugin list. The obsolete three-entry list was removed without changing v1/v2 rendered settings. Do not feed rendered production agent permissions back into the raw-source renderer. Credentials are scrubbed unless explicit private production staging is requested.

skillsDir.role: Personal-only installation tree: 11 skills, 34 files with preserved bytes and modes. All eight OMO bundled names are excluded, including the retired codemap/deepwork/oh-my-opencode-slim overrides. Same-name personal inputs are refused. The historical generated/ directory name is retained; the mixed stock-patching generator and its manifest no longer maintain this tree.

claudeAdvisor.note: Per-flavor entry map (v1 index.v1.mjs vs v2 index.js sibling files in one dir) — stage.mjs resolves entry/testedEntrySha256 by flavor. stagingDir plugins/claude-advisor mirrors the live deployed dir name so activation replaces it in place (a differently named managed dir would leave the live tree discovered as a twin). v1: the explicit plugin entry references the lane's discovery shim plugins/claude-advisor/index.js (re-exporting ./index.v1.mjs) — one load path. v2: DISCOVERY ONLY via the staged index.js — NO rendered config entry, because a config entry plus discovery would load the plugin twice (matches the live deploy). Takes no options. Entry selection is pinned explicitly per flavor (v1 index.v1.mjs / v2 index.js); index.mjs-vs-index.js discovery precedence is UNRESOLVED (A7 smoke 2026-10-20: smoke host preferred index.mjs, live host loaded index.js with both present) — stage.mjs refuses any staged dir exposing index.mjs at its discovery root.

Entry named index.js at the staged root: index.mjs-vs-index.js discovery precedence is unresolved and refused by stage.mjs. Debug log /tmp/opencode/stale-debug.log when the plugin's dbg() fires.

supervisor.note: Real deployed layout (2026-10-20): managed-plugins/supervisor — OUTSIDE the plugins/ discovery root, registered by config entry ONLY (stagingDir override places the staged copy there; config entry plus a discovered index.js inside plugins/ would twin). Mode default in lib/config.mjs is 'observe' — only the exact string 'inject' is honored. Both flavors pin {"mode":"inject"}: v1 renders the explicit entry as the tuple ["./managed-plugins/supervisor/index.js", {"mode":"inject"}] (path is the lane shim re-exporting ./index.v1.mjs); v2 renders {"package":"./managed-plugins/supervisor","options":{"mode":"inject"}} via v2Options (options reach setup() through ctx.options) — byte-for-byte the live config's entry form. Staging REAL COPIES de-symlinks the live managed-plugins/supervisor symlink on activation (desired). Same entry-pinning rule as claudeAdvisor: index.mjs discovery precedence unresolved — staged dir must not expose index.mjs at its config/discovery root (enforced by stage.mjs).
